flow.name: requests-approve-flow
flow.doc:description: Approves a PENDING request and applies it through papi-orders; ends COMPLETED (correction.applied once) or FAILED

choice.doc:description: A PENDING request past its deadline expires instead of being approved

raise-error.description: The request expired without a decision

set-variable.doc:description: PENDING to APPROVED by the approver
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { 'from': 'PENDING', to: 'APPROVED', decision: true, reason: null, note: 'Approved' }]

flow-ref.name: request-apply-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: APPLYING, papi-orders correction, COMPLETED or FAILED

flow.name: requests-reject-flow
flow.doc:description: Rejects a PENDING request with a reason; nothing is applied or published

set-variable.doc:description: PENDING to REJECTED by the approver
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { 'from': 'PENDING', to: 'REJECTED', decision: true, reason: vars.rejectReason, note: vars.rejectReason }]

flow.name: requests-retry-flow
flow.doc:description: Applies a FAILED request again with the same key (papi-orders moves nothing twice)

choice.doc:description: Only a FAILED request is retried

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'The request is ' ++ vars.requestRow.STATUS ++ '; only a FAILED request can be retried']

flow-ref.name: request-apply-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: APPLYING, papi-orders correction, COMPLETED or FAILED

sub-flow.name: decision-prepare-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Only approvers decide (403 otherwise, D10); reads the current request (404) and whether it is past its deadline

when.expression: #[output application/java --- do { import isApprover from modules::requests --- not isApprover(vars.actor, p('approval.approverClientIds')) }]
when.doc:description: The caller is not a configured approver

raise-error.description: Only an approver can decide on a request

db:select.doc:description: Current status and whether the deadline passed
db:select.db:sql: SELECT STATUS, CASE WHEN EXPIRES_AT < SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_EXPIRED FROM ORDER_REQUESTS WHERE ID = :id

choice.doc:description: 404 when the request does not exist

sub-flow.name: request-transition-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Moves vars.requestId from vars.transition.from to .to with a history step; 409 when it is not in the expected status

db:update.doc:description: Changes the status only from the expected one (avoids double decisions)
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE ORDER_REQUESTS SET STATUS = :toStatus, DECIDED_BY = CASE WHEN :decision = 1 THEN :actor ELSE DECIDED_BY END, DECIDED_AT = CASE WHEN :decision = 1 THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE DECIDED_AT END, REASON = NVL(:reason, REASON), UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = :id AND STATUS = :fromStatus
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { id: vars.requestId, fromStatus: vars.transition.'from', toStatus: vars.transition.to, decision: if (vars.transition.decision default false) 1 else 0, actor: vars.actor default p('requests.defaultActor'), reason: vars.transition.reason }]

choice.doc:description: No updated row: the request is no longer in the expected status

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'The request is ' ++ (vars.requestRow.STATUS default 'in another status') ++ '; it cannot move from ' ++ vars.transition.'from' ++ ' to ' ++ vars.transition.to]

db:insert.doc:description: History step with who and when
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO ORDER_REQUEST_EVENTS (ID, REQUEST_ID, FROM_STATUS, TO_STATUS, ACTOR, DETAIL) VALUES (:id, :requestId, :fromStatus, :toStatus, :actor, :detail)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { id: uuid(), requestId: vars.requestId, fromStatus: vars.transition.'from', toStatus: vars.transition.to, actor: vars.transition.actor default (vars.actor default p('requests.defaultActor')), detail: vars.transition.note }]

sub-flow.name: request-apply-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: APPLYING, then papi-orders applies the correction with the request key: COMPLETED and correction.applied once, or FAILED

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { 'from': vars.applyFrom, to: 'APPLYING', decision: false, actor: 'papi-order-requests', note: 'Applying the correction' }]

db:select.doc:description: Order, type, key and detail of the request
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, REQUEST_TYPE, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, ITEM_ID, PROVIDER_ABV, QTY FROM ORDER_REQUESTS WHERE ID = :id

try.doc:description: A failed correction ends FAILED and publishes nothing

http:request.doc:description: papi-orders applies the correction once per key (D7)

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { 'from': 'APPLYING', to: 'COMPLETED', decision: false, actor: 'papi-order-requests', note: 'Dispatch note ' ++ (vars.correctionResult.dispatchNote.dispatchNoteId default '') }]

flow-ref.name: publish-correction-applied-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: The only customer email of a correction (D18)

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { 'from': 'APPLYING', to: 'FAILED', decision: false, actor: 'papi-order-requests', note: do { var d = error.description default 'Correction failed' --- if (sizeOf(d) > 990) d[0 to 989] else d } }]

sub-flow.name: publish-correction-applied-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: correction.applied once, when the request is COMPLETED (D18); a broker failure is logged

try.doc:description: The correction is already applied: a failed announcement does not undo it

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - correction.applied not published for request ' ++ vars.requestId ++ ': ' ++ (error.description default '')]

flow.name: requests-expiry-scheduler-flow
flow.doc:description: Every 5 minutes marks EXPIRED the PENDING requests past their deadline (24 h without a decision)

sub-flow.name: requests-expire-due-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: PENDING requests past their deadline become EXPIRED, each with its history step

db:select.db:sql: SELECT ID FROM ORDER_REQUESTS WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' AND EXPIRES_AT < SYSTIMESTAMP

try.doc:description: A request decided in the meantime is skipped

sub-flow.name: request-expire-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: PENDING to EXPIRED by the system

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { 'from': 'PENDING', to: 'EXPIRED', decision: false, actor: 'papi-order-requests', note: 'No decision within ' ++ p('requests.expiryHours') ++ ' h' }]
